character.motivation: Wants to be trusted with a repair people will notice. Takes extra shifts to avoid admitting that he likes company.
character.voice: Earnest, self-deprecating, explains things by taking them apart.
character.backstory: Niko learned carpentry on flood salvage, practicing on pieces Sol had already judged too damaged to reuse. He wants a public repair that residents can trust him to finish.
character.quest_hook: Give Niko a chance to build the hearing noticeboard and ask the families what it should protect from rain and what it should make easy to read.

dialogue.introduction: If a hinge squeaks, at least it has the decency to tell you where it hurts.
dialogue.friendship: Sol lets me fix things twice. The first time I learn what broke. The second time I learn what I broke.
dialogue.supper: They asked me to fix a wobbling bench. I thought I'd been invited to sit. Turns out it was both.
dialogue.hearing: I can build a proper public noticeboard. I'd like the hinges to outlast whoever's in office.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I needed stuffing for a drafty window. This will do nicely.
dialogue.disliked_gift: A turnip rolls off every workbench I own. Trust me on this.

routine.hobby: Looks for spare parts near Market Lane
routine.home_context: Settled next to Sol so the pair can sort salvage and work on repairs together.
